intro.title: Notes From the
intro.description: I'm building toward writing regularly about the engineering and business problems that show up once real systems are running — bookings, payments, multi-tenant architecture, and the parts of software that get complicated the moment an actual business depends on them.
intro.statusLine: Nothing's published here yet. Consider this page a public commitment rather than a placeholder — as I write, it goes here first.
